description: Single video editing operations via agentic-editor.ts. Each command is a standalone ffmpeg operation. Run via: npm run agentic:editor <command> [options]

common_flags.--input: Input video file path (required for most commands)
common_flags.--files: Comma-separated file list for merge/split operations

examples.description: Cut a video to a specific time range
examples.usage: npm run agentic:editor trim --input input.mp4 --start 00:05 --end 00:30 --output trimmed.mp4
npm run agentic:editor speed --input input.mp4 --rate 2.0 --output fast.mp4
npm run agentic:editor extract-audio --input input.mp4 --output audio.mp3

examples.description: Replace the audio track of a video
examples.usage: npm run agentic:editor replace-audio --input video.mp4 --audio new_audio.mp3 --output re Audiod.mp4

examples.description: Remove all audio from a video
examples.usage: npm run agentic:editor mute --input input.mp4 --output silent.mp4
npm run agentic:editor split --input input.mp4 --at 00:15 --output-prefix part
npm run agentic:editor merge --files "part1.mp4,part2.mp4,part3.mp4" --output merged.mp4
npm run agentic:editor crop --input input.mp4 --preset 9:16 --output cropped.mp4
npm run agentic:editor resize --input input.mp4 --width 1080 --height 1920 --output resized.mp4
npm run agentic:editor rotate --input input.mp4 --angle 90 --output rotated.mp4
npm run agentic:editor loop --input clip.mp4 --count 3 --output looped.mp4
npm run agentic:editor overlay-text --input input.mp4 --text "Hello World" --position bottom-left --output captioned.mp4
npm run agentic:editor overlay-image --input input.mp4 --image logo.png --position top-right --output branded.mp4

examples.description: Save a single video frame as image
examples.usage: npm run agentic:editor extract-frame --input input.mp4 --at 00:10 --output frame.png
npm run agentic:editor thumbnail --input input.mp4 --output thumbnail.jpg

examples.description: Blur a region of the frame (privacy)
examples.usage: npm run agentic:editor blur --input input.mp4 --region 100:200:300:400 --output blurred.mp4
npm run agentic:editor adjust --input input.mp4 --brightness 0.1 --contrast 1.2 --saturation 1.5 --output adjusted.mp4
npm run agentic:editor reverse --input input.mp4 --output reversed.mp4
npm run agentic:editor info --input input.mp4

examples.description: Extract one scene from rendered workspace video
examples.usage: npm run agentic:editor concat-scene --job avs_test_job --scene 3
